programs.title: Holland
programs.desc: Nancy Vandergroot (Nicole Kidman) tries to fulfill her duties as a housewife perfectly.She lives a seemingly perfect life with her husband (Matthew Macfadyen) and son (Jude Hill) in the tulip-filled town of Holland, Michigan.He is an important member of a close-knit community.One day, the woman and her friend Dave (Gael García Bernal) discover a secret.They begin to suspect that nothing in their lives is what it seems.While searching for the dark truth, they expose themselves to danger.The film was directed by Mimi Cave, who made her debut in 2022 with the horror film "Fresh", well received by critics and viewers.

programs.title: The Inventor
programs.desc: The brilliant inventor Leonardo da Vinci cannot satisfy his enormous curiosity about the world.In search of inspiration, he leaves Italy and lives at the French court, where he can freely experiment by inventing flying machines, amazing vehicles and examining the human body.He comes up with the idea of ​​creating an ideal city and, together with the adventurous and bold Princess Margaret, tries to convince the ruler of his vision.Together they are also looking for answers about the meaning of life.However, the king expects something down-to-earth from the artist and researcher - he wants a large statue to show the world his power.

programs.title: Frieda's Case
programs.desc: The year 1904. A seamstress accused of a crime becomes the center of a trial that exposes the injustices of the legal system.

programs.title: Superman
programs.desc: Superman (David Corenswet) stops the president of Boravia from invading Jarhanpur.This brings down the ire of Lex Luthor (Nicholas Hoult), who had an interest in this war.After returning to Metropolis, the superman is defeated by a strongman serving his enemy called the Hammer of Boravia.Luthor also broadcasts a message from Superman's parents to the entire country, urging him to conquer the Earth.Although Lois Lane (Rachel Brosnahan), the girlfriend of superhero Clark Kent's alter ego, assures him that she believes in his goodness, he wants to clear his name.He surrenders to the US authorities, who hand him over to Luthor.The antagonist traps Superman in an alternate reality along with his other enemies.Lois frees her beloved, and when he recovers in the home of his adoptive parents, Martha (Neva Howell) and Jonathan (Pruitt Taylor Vince), he once again fights for peace, with the help of members of the Justice Gang.Meanwhile, Lois is busy exposing Luthor's shenanigans to the public.

programs.title: Veep 5
programs.desc: The story of Vice President Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) continues, as she and her colleagues want to achieve something significant in politics.The woman avoids deals, scandals and corruption.She is assisted in her daily work by Amy, her office manager (Anna Chlumsky), spokesman Mike McLintock (Matt Walsh), general counsel Gary (Tony Hale) and secretary Sue (Sufe Bradshaw).When Selina Meyer unexpectedly takes over as president after her predecessor stepped down, the entire team must meet a new challenge.
